items.title: Welcome to the pad
items.text: This is your Main Rig. Defend it by night, grow the field by day. Move with WASD or the left stick.

items.title: Swing the bit
items.text: Attack with Left Mouse, J or the A button. Hold it to keep swinging. Give it a few swings now.

items.title: Barrels
items.text: Barrels (top left) are your money. Walk onto a glowing slot marked Pumpjack and hold E (or X) to build. Pumpjacks pay out every dawn.

items.title: Block the lane
items.text: Red arrows show where tonight's enemies come from. Build a Blast Wall slot across that lane.

items.title: Raise a tower
items.text: Derrick Towers shoot anything in range, ground or air. Build one beside the lane.

items.title: Start the night
items.text: When you're ready, hold N (or Y) to sound the night horn. Enemies only come when you call the night.

items.title: Hold the line
items.text: Fight alongside your towers. Use your class ability with Right Mouse, K or the B button.

items.title: Dawn and the wheel
items.text: Every night you clear earns a spin of the reward wheel. Rarer segments give bigger rewards and permanent unlocks.

items.title: Hire a crew
items.text: Build a Crew Camp and choose a crew. Then hold F (or the right bumper) to call nearby units to follow you, and release F to make them hold that spot.

items.title: You're certified
items.text: That's the job: build by day, defend by night, and it gets a little harder every night. Bosses come every 7th night. Good luck, engineer.
